impact.affected_asset: GitHub Shop visitors' browser execution context.
impact.attacker_capability: Choose the URL used as a dynamically added script's src after injecting reflected non-script markup.
impact.security_effect: Client-side cross-site scripting through loading an attacker-selected script.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker injects non-script DOM markup through reflected search or URL-query content, including nested anchor elements with id BOOMR and name url and an attacker-chosen href.

The initial script defines BOOMR but invokes a clobberable native method; double clobbering makes that invocation fail during parsing, leaving BOOMR undefined, after which named DOM properties can supply window.BOOMR.url from the injected anchors.
A later script reads window.BOOMR.url and uses it as the src of a dynamically added script, so the DOM-derived href controls a script-load security sink.
Controlling that dynamic script source escalates the case to client-side cross-site scripting.

failure.operation: Dynamic script creation with src assigned from window.BOOMR.url

primary_invariant.kind: DOM-named-property isolation for security-sensitive script configuration
primary_invariant.statement: The dynamic script loader must obtain BOOMR.url from an application-controlled BOOMR object rather than a browser-exposed named DOM property created by injected markup.
primary_invariant.violated_because: A parsing-stopping error leaves BOOMR undefined, and injected elements named BOOMR and url then supply window.BOOMR.url through DOM named-property behavior.

quality.review_notes: The paper gives a concrete GitHub Shop mechanism, reflected-markup injection paths, payload shape, and XSS consequence, and says affected parties had patched the cases. It does not supply a GitHub-owned advisory, source revision, vendor patch diff, exact affected version, or an inspected case-specific executable test. Repository material establishes general browser-testing and payload-generation tooling, not an observed run or a GitHub-Shop-specific oracle.

remediation.invariant_restored: A script-loading URL is sourced from an explicitly application-controlled configuration object and cannot be replaced by named properties of injected DOM elements.
mitigation_classes: Eliminate or guard vulnerable DOM named-property access patterns before values reach security-sensitive JavaScript operations.
Prevent attacker-injected markup from defining the names consumed by sensitive application code.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: GitHub Shop case documented in the IEEE S&P 2023 paper; no affected GitHub version or vendor commit is supplied.

target.component: Boomerang JavaScript library integration and dynamic script loader
